name: guided-click-through
description: Verify the behaviour of a change to a web interface with the component tests of the project, then give the user a short click-through for what tests cannot show, such as layout, styles and visible focus. The agent does not run the app or a browser. It fixes the steps that the user reports as failed.

interface.shortDescription: Test a UI change with component tests, then get a short click-through for the visuals.
